convert_chameleon_weights_to_hf: convert Chameleon model weights from Meta format to HuggingFace Transformers format
build_chameleon_model_conversion: build a Chameleon model checkpoint in HuggingFace format with configurable model size
test_chameleon_conversion_inference: test the converted Chameleon model with single-image and multi-image generation inference
run_chameleon_weight_conversion: run the CLI tool to convert 7B or 30B Chameleon weights to HuggingFace format
summarize_chameleon_weight_mapping: summarize the weight mapping between Chameleon original checkpoints and HuggingFace model structure
